Labelled 2026-10-15 by an AI agent (Claude) against _rubric, for trend_relevance.
_rubric: relevant = a U.S. policy, government or civic story a Civitas reader would want: the U.S. government acting, U.S. courts on law or government, U.S. elections and campaigns, U.S. policy issues, U.S. foreign and military policy with the U.S. government as an actor. Not relevant: foreign politics with no U.S. actor, sports, entertainment, business without a regulatory angle, celebrity, memes.
